text:
Maria G: quick heads-up — draft release notes ready for review, aiming to blast internal announce at 17:00 PT. can ppl eyeball the snippets? :eyes:
Leo K: sending the draft now. will we pin v2.14.0 across the region or stagger?
Sabrina L: copying in docs PR link: https://phab/repo/PR-4821. i trimmed the customer-facing bullets.
Maria G: thanks. preference is pin to 2.14.0 for hosted and dedicated; private customers get advisory. we want consistent comms.
Aj (oncall): confirm rollback window? if deploybot sees >2% 5m error rate do we auto-roll?
Leo K: prefer manual rollback by oncall if latency SLO break. deploybot auto-fallback only for model-inference OOMs.
Maria G: ok annotate that in the internal note — point people to rollback playbook and who to contact.
Sabrina L: draft snippet for internal announce (short):
```
Heads-up: We're releasing 2.14.0 today at 17:00 PT. Key changes: runtime batching improvements (reduces tail latency on small prompts), new pinning option for model variants, and minor console UX polish. See runbook for rollback criteria and owner list. Oncall: @Aj will lead rollback decisions.
```
Maria G: nice. add the canary/standby matrix line.
Sabrina L: added: "Canary rollout: 5% traffic for 30m, monitor token latency and error rate. Auto-fallback to previous model variant on SIGTERM/OOMs."
deploy-bot: preflight: staging health OK, canary snapshot created (snap-2026-03-23-1712).
Leo K: pinning note: we should include exact model hashes for reproducibility. i'll paste the three hashes in the final draft.
Maria G: place them in parentheses after each model name. also call out the Dedicated SLA/latency owners.
Aj (oncall): on rollback criteria — propose: error rate >= 2% over 5m OR P95 token latency increase > 40% AND user-facing regression flagged by product sample tests. If both conditions true, escalate to full rollback.
Sabrina L: i'll add that wording to the runbook snippet and internal note.
Leo K: timeline check — ops needs the pinned release note by 16:00 PT for the deploybot announcement. can we ship that?
Maria G: yes. Sabrina can you push the final copy by 15:30 so engineering has an hour to append hashes and owners?
Sabrina L: yup — i'll do a final pass and drop it in this thread + PR. prepping a one-liner for the deploybot announce too.
Maria G: one-liner should be: "Deploy 2.14.0 to hosted/dedicated. Canary 5% -> 30m; rollback criteria in internal note." keep it compact.
deploy-bot: reminder: scheduled deploy window 17:00-18:00 PT. set quiet-mode notifications to #eng-oncall.
Leo K: i'll attach the model hashes in a follow-up message.
Maria G: thanks all. final checklist: (1) Sabrina final copy by 15:30, (2) Leo paste model hashes by 16:00, (3) Aj confirm oncall standby and rollback matrix, (4) deploybot scheduled. :thumbsup:
Sabrina L: done — final copy posted in PR and pasted below.
```
Internal announce: 2.14.0 releasing 17:00 PT. Highlights: batching perf + model pinning UI. Canary: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 30m -> full. Rollback: error rate >=2% over 5m OR P95 latency +40% + failed regression checks -> escalate. Owners: Maria G (PM), Leo K (Eng release), Aj (Oncall). Model hashes: m/v1@sha256:abcd1234, m/v2@sha256:efgh5678, m/v2-quant@sha256:ijkl9012. Deploy contact: @deploybot.
```
Aj (oncall): i'm on standby 16:30-19:00. will monitor canary dashboards and take action if thresholds met.
Maria G: perfect. i'll drop the internal announce at 17:05 with the one-liner to staff. thanks team. :rocket:
